body:
Part of [GoodWatch living roadmap](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/52).

Mode: HITL

## Question

Which discovery or Fingerprint opportunities address a meaningful user need strongly enough to pursue, and which are speculative expansion?

Compare clearer roles for Search/Explore/Discover, filter and ordering improvements, richer taste dimensions, multi-title similarity, guides, and visual exploration. Clarify Fingerprint/DNA terminology and existing capabilities before combining model, data, and interface changes. Treat alternative engines and clustering experiments as candidate means to a user outcome.

Source: [discovery and Fingerprint backlog](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/52#issuecomment-5686674322). Use relevant code and market evidence already collected; identify any new research needed.

Resolve with candidate outcomes, their evidence and prerequisites, ideas to retain or defer, and bounded destinations for the most promising follow-up work.

## Context from recurring-use discussion

[Explore reasons to return and the role of the personal library](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/57#issuecomment-5687944168) records the user-confirmed direction. The user specifically wants easier recommendation browsing by mood or Fingerprint attributes, considers the current pillars unhelpful, and explicitly chose this ticket for investigating why and what should change. Preserve the example “Game of Thrones, but sci-fi,” alongside “tense but not bleak,” “something strange and dreamlike,” and “clever dialogue, little action.”

Determine whether the issue is dimensions, assigned data, controls, recommendation results, or a combination; no diagnosis or pillar replacement is agreed. The examples express desired outcomes without selecting a free-text interface. Coordinate with the existing continuous recommendation scope decision rather than duplicating it.

comments.body:
## Resolution — understandable discovery and exploration

Confirmed with the user in the live wayfinder discussion on 2026-09-15.

### Agreed directions

- Give **finding something to watch and enjoyable open-ended exploration equal investigation**. This is equal consideration, not an allocation of effort or a delivery commitment.
- Investigate understandable alternatives to the current pillars, starting from the existing **74 Fingerprint attributes**. The user's concrete friction is meaning: Humor is fairly clear, while Energy, Heart, World, Craft, and Style are ambiguous or unknown. This establishes a comprehension problem for this user; it does not establish bad underlying data or poor recommendation results.
- Explore **selective similarity** through requests such as “Game of Thrones, but sci-fi.” Which attributes to preserve or change must be investigated. Political intrigue, competing factions, and consequential characters were an assistant suggestion, not a user-selected interpretation.
- Retain discovering unexpected connections, understanding individual titles more deeply, and finding unfamiliar corners of cinema as open-ended exploration outcomes to investigate.
- Assess the existing attributes against concrete examples before prototyping browsing and exploration. Preserve “tense but not bleak,” “something strange and dreamlike,” and “clever dialogue, little action.” These examples do not select a free-text interface.

### Evidence and terminology

A read-only code inspection found six current pillars summarizing selected subsets of the 74 numerical attributes. Thematic attributes such as fantasy, futuristic, and political are outside those pillar mappings. Display aggregates and discovery thresholds use different rules; these are investigation leads, not a runtime diagnosis or a decision to replace the schema.

- [Fingerprint dimensions and pillar calculations](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/blob/7cab71eb21bd80ee23fb986ad8ebc78fb1242034/goodwatch-webapp/app/server/utils/fingerprint.ts#L3): definitions and mappings; display aggregation begins around line 169.
- [Current Fingerprint controls](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/blob/7cab71eb21bd80ee23fb986ad8ebc78fb1242034/goodwatch-webapp/app/ui/filter/sections/SectionFingerprint.tsx#L9): multiple pillars with a shared Low/Mid/High selection.
- [Discovery filtering](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/blob/7cab71eb21bd80ee23fb986ad8ebc78fb1242034/goodwatch-webapp/app/server/discover.server.ts#L525): component-threshold conditions differ from display calculations.
- [Discovery candidate retrieval](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/blob/7cab71eb21bd80ee23fb986ad8ebc78fb1242034/goodwatch-webapp/app/server/discover.server.ts#L347) and [ordering](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/blob/7cab71eb21bd80ee23fb986ad8ebc78fb1242034/goodwatch-webapp/app/server/discover.server.ts#L638): vector candidates precede SQL filters and final ordering; quality and runtime behavior remain unverified.

Fingerprint is the current user-facing label in the inspected discovery controls and title details. DNA remains in internal types and older tag-oriented components; its presence does not establish a separate active discovery capability. This records observed terminology, not a user-approved rename or new glossary distinction.

The user's feedback and confirmed direction establish product intent. No runtime evaluation, catalog-wide accuracy assessment, broader demand validation, or new competitor-effectiveness claim was made in this session.

### Bounded follow-up destinations

1. Determine how well the existing attributes express concrete discovery requests, distinguishing unclear language, missing dimensions, assigned-data problems, and matching behavior. Record supported examples and unresolved evidence before choosing interface changes.
2. Use a throwaway prototype to choose an understandable way to browse attributes and steer similarity, grounded in the assessment and reviewed with the user.
3. Use a throwaway prototype to choose promising open-ended exploration interactions around connections, understanding titles, and unfamiliar cinema, with equal consideration to watch selection.

The two prototype discussions depend on the attribute assessment. They should produce bounded follow-up scope or focused-map destinations, not production changes. Runtime examples or deeper research should be requested where the assessment reveals a specific unanswered question.

### Retained possibilities and boundaries

New dimensions, alternative engines, clustering, embeddings, graphs, maps, guides, multi-title comparisons, and similarity percentages remain possible means, not selected features or technology commitments. Concrete attributes, explained categories, and guided combinations remain design alternatives; the user did not choose a control format. Navigation roles, filters, and ordering should be examined as they affect these outcomes; a separate Search/Explore/Discover redesign is not approved.

Coordinate with [Choose the scope of a continuous recommendation experience](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/66), which owns recommendation continuity, onboarding, availability, and related journey scope. This decision owns discovery steering and exploration and does not duplicate that work. [Choose the next focus across the backlog](https://github.com/alp82/goodwatch-monorepo/issues/65) retains cross-area prioritization.

No backlog idea is permanently ruled out. Production implementation is outside this planning pass. Weak expressiveness, unreliable attribute assignments, poor results, or unconvincing prototype feedback may narrow or change the candidate directions.

title: Choose worthwhile discovery and Fingerprint directions
